description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useMe' that fetches the current user's data from a backend API using Supabase authentication. It manages state for user data, loading status, and errors, and provides functions to refetch user info and ping a protected API endpoint.

methods.name: useMe
methods.description: Custom React hook to fetch and manage current user data, handle loading and error states, and provide utility functions for API interactions.
